SELECT d.x FROM (SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 2) d WHERE d.x<3 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT a.x,b.x FROM (SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 2) a FULL JOIN (SELECT x FROM u ORDER BY x LIMIT 2) b ON a.x=b.x WHERE a.x>2 OR b.x>2 ORDER BY a.x,b.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 5)d WHERE d.x>1 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET ?1)d WHERE d.x>0 ORDER BY d.x DESC
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT ?1)d WHERE d.x>1 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t WHERE x<0 ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE d.x>0 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT NULL AS x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE d.x IS NULL ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x%2 AS x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 3)d WHERE d.x>=0 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.nm FROM(SELECT nm COLLATE nocase AS nm FROM t ORDER BY nm LIMIT 3)d WHERE d.nm='T' ORDER BY d.nm
SELECT d.x,(SELECT d.x) AS v FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE d.x>0 ORDER BY d.x
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE d.x>(SELECT 1) ORDER BY d.x
SELECT a.x,b.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1)a FULL JOIN(SELECT x FROM u ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1)b ON a.x=b.x WHERE a.x IS NULL OR b.x IS NULL ORDER BY a.x,b.x
SELECT d.missing FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE d.x>0
SELECT d.x FROM(SELECT x FROM t ORDER BY x LIMIT 2)d WHERE json_extract('bad','$')>0 ORDER BY d.x
